title: Bochner and null-set transfer from a lintegral transfer identity
statement:
Let n, l be natural numbers and mu a measure on R^{n+l}. Let S be an arbitrary subset of R^{n+l}, A a Borel subset of R^n (MeasurableSet A), G : R^n -> R^{n+l} a Borel map, and W : R^n -> R a Borel function with W(x) >= 0 for every x.
Assume the lintegral transfer identity: for every Borel phi : R^{n+l} -> [0, infinity], int_S phi dmu = int_A ofReal(W(x)) phi(G(x)) dL^n(x). These are lower integrals; int_S is against mu restricted to S, and int_A is against Lebesgue measure L^n = volume restricted to A.
Then:
(i) for every Borel phi : R^{n+l} -> R, int_S phi dmu = int_A W(x) phi(G(x)) dL^n(x) as Bochner integrals. Lean's convention gives a non-integrable function integral 0, and the identity holds for every Borel phi, integrable or not;
(ii) for every set Z of R^{n+l} with mu(Z) = 0, for L^n-a.e. x: if x is in A and G(x) is in Z, then W(x) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (S : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (A : Set (Rn n)) (G : Rn n → Amb n ℓ) (W : Rn n → ℝ), MeasurableSet A → Measurable G → Measurable W → (∀ x, 0 ≤ W x) → (∀ φ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → ∫⁻ y in S, φ y ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in A, ENNReal.ofReal (W x) * φ (G x)) → (∀ φ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ, Measurable φ → ∫ y in S, φ y ∂μ = ∫ x in A, W x * φ (G x)) ∧ ∀ Z : Set (Amb n ℓ), μ Z = 0 → ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Rn n)), x ∈ A → G x ∈ Z → W x = 0
